llm_response.reason: The website uses a misleading URL (self-portrait.com.de) combining designer brand names but selling 'Acne Studios' items, which is disconnected from both official brand domains. It employs aggressive marketing (free shipping/returns, outlet sale), lacks WHOIS transparency, and misuses brand identity—hallmarks of fake shopping scams. The privacy and contact information are ambiguous, further supporting the scam classification.
